stem.text: A battery has an e.m.f. $E$ and internal resistance $r$. The battery delivers a current $I$ to a variable resistor and the p.d. across its terminals is $V$.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a battery shown inside a dashed box, labelled E for its e.m.f. and r for its internal resistance, connected in series with a variable resistor. Labels I and V mark the current and the terminal voltage.

stem.text: The variable resistor is adjusted so that $I$ increases.

D.text: The resistance of the variable resistor increases.
